_note: Our own curated catalogue of service tasks, written for this app. Each task says in plain English what the job is, what must be true before it runs, and how to recognise the INPA key that performs it. Nothing here is copied from BMW documentation: the only BMW strings are job and menu-proc names, which are identifiers the scripts themselves carry and which the resolver has to match on. tools/export/service_functions.py turns this file plus the decoded IR into data/service-functions.chassis.json, the per-chassis mapping the app reads.
_match: A task resolves against one menu item of one module script. `modules` narrows which scripts may answer (matched against the SGBD and the module's label, case-insensitive). `jobs` matches the item's job name; `keys` matches its printed label. `deny` rejects an item whose label matches it, and exists because INPA reuses one job name across keys that mean different things. An item must satisfy the module filter AND (a job hit OR a label hit), and its write-ness must agree with `risk` -- a task marked write never resolves onto a read-only key, which is the failure that would send someone to a key that does nothing.

tasks.name: Steering angle sensor calibration
tasks.what: Teaches the steering angle sensor where straight ahead is, by writing the current wheel position as the zero offset. Needed after the sensor, the steering rack or the airbag clock spring is disturbed, and whenever DSC reports an implausible steering angle.
before: ignition on, engine off
wheels pointing straight ahead, car on level ground
steering wheel centred and not held under load
tasks.after: Read the adjustment values back and confirm the offset now reads near zero with the wheels straight.

tasks.name: Transmission adaptation reset
tasks.what: Clears the shift and clutch-fill values the automatic transmission control unit learned over its life, so it relearns them from the base map. Used after a valve body, torque converter or fluid service, and to clear harsh shifting that survives a fluid change.
before: engine at operating temperature
selector in P, engine idling or ignition on per the script's own prompt
no transmission faults stored that would immediately re-adapt to a defect
tasks.after: Drive the car gently through the full shift range so the module relearns; shifts are often rough for the first few miles.

tasks.name: Engine adaptation reset
tasks.what: Clears the values the engine control unit learned about this particular engine: mixture trims, idle position, knock retard. Used after intake or fuelling work so the module stops compensating for a fault that has been repaired.
before: engine at operating temperature
no unresolved intake leaks or fuelling faults, or the module simply relearns the same trims
engine idling or ignition on as the script asks
tasks.after: Let the engine idle until the fans cycle, then drive through part and full load so the trims relearn.

tasks.name: Throttle and idle adaptation reset
tasks.what: Clears just the throttle body and idle control adaptations, leaving the rest of the engine's learned values alone. The usual fix after cleaning or replacing a throttle body, when idle hangs or hunts because the module is still compensating for the old part.
before: engine at operating temperature
throttle body clean and fully seated, electrical connector home
no throttle position faults stored
tasks.after: Let the engine idle undisturbed for a couple of minutes without touching the throttle so the base position relearns.

keys: adaption value idle speed regulation delete

tasks.name: Mixture and knock adaptation reset
tasks.what: Clears the fuel-trim and knock-control values learned from the lambda sensors and knock sensors. Used after fixing a vacuum leak, a lambda sensor or a fuelling fault, so the module stops carrying the old correction.
before: engine at operating temperature
the underlying fuelling or intake fault actually repaired first
lambda sensors working and their faults cleared
tasks.after: Drive through idle, part load and full load so the trims relearn; recheck them afterwards to confirm they settle near zero.

tasks.name: Service interval / CBS reset
tasks.what: Resets the service counters the instrument cluster counts down: oil service and the distance or time inspection on SI cars, or the individual Condition Based Service items on later ones. Run it after the work is actually done, not before.
before: ignition on, engine off
the service the counter tracks actually carried out
on CBS cars, know which item you are resetting; they reset one at a time
tasks.after: Read the service data back and confirm the counter has returned to its full interval.

tasks.name: Battery replacement registration
tasks.what: Tells the power management that a new battery is fitted, so the charging strategy and the state-of-charge model start from a fresh battery instead of the tired one they were tracking. Cars with an intelligent battery sensor (IBS) need this or the new battery is chronically undercharged.
before: the new battery actually fitted and its terminals tight
ignition on, engine off
battery capacity and type match what the car expects, or register the change too where the script offers it
tasks.after: Read the power management values back and confirm the registration counter or date has moved.

tasks.name: DME to EWS alignment
tasks.what: Re-synchronises the rolling start value the engine control unit and the immobiliser (EWS, later CAS) share, so the immobiliser will release the engine. Needed after either module is replaced or swapped between cars, when the engine cranks but will not fire.
before: ignition on, engine off
both the engine module and the immobiliser present on the bus and answering
the correct key in the ignition, not a spare that was never taught
tasks.after: Try to start the engine; a successful alignment lets it fire and clears the immobiliser fault.

tasks.name: Injector coding (IMA values)
tasks.what: Writes each injector's own flow-correction code into the engine control unit, so it can compensate for the spread between injectors. Every injector carries this code on its body; it must be re-entered whenever an injector is moved or replaced, or that cylinder runs rich or lean.
before: ignition on, engine off
the IMA code read off each injector and matched to its cylinder number
injectors installed in the cylinders whose codes you are about to enter
tasks.after: Read the coded values back per cylinder and confirm each one matches the code on that injector.

keys: Write IMA values for all cylinders
Write IMA value for single cylinder

tasks.name: Injector adaptation reset
tasks.what: Clears the per-injector delivery corrections the engine control unit learned, separately from the IMA codes written on the injector bodies. Run it after injectors are swapped or replaced so the module relearns against the new parts rather than the old ones.
before: the injector work finished and the IMA codes entered first, where the engine uses them
engine at operating temperature
no injector faults stored
tasks.after: Run the engine through idle and load so the corrections relearn, then read them back.

tasks.name: Brake bleeding (DSC pump routine)
tasks.what: Cycles the DSC or ABS hydraulic unit's valves and pump so trapped air is pushed out of the control block, which a pedal-only bleed cannot reach. Run as part of a bleed after the hydraulic unit or its lines have been opened.
before: reservoir topped up and kept topped up throughout; running it dry pulls air back in
ignition on, engine off
a bleed bottle on each caliper and a helper or pressure bleeder ready
the conventional bleed at each caliper done first, in the order the routine asks
tasks.after: Finish the conventional bleed at each corner, check pedal feel and top the reservoir to the mark.

tasks.name: DSC sensor offset calibration
tasks.what: Zeroes the yaw rate, lateral and longitudinal acceleration and brake pressure sensors DSC uses to decide the car is sliding. Needed after the sensor cluster or the hydraulic unit is replaced, and whenever DSC reports an implausible sensor offset.
before: car standing still on level ground, ignition on, engine off
nobody moving in or around the car while it runs; the sensors read the disturbance
steering straight ahead and the brake pedal released
tasks.after: Read the sensor status back and confirm the offsets sit near zero with the car stationary.

tasks.name: Ride height calibration
tasks.what: Writes the current suspension height as the target the self-levelling or air suspension control unit holds. Needed after a height sensor, a link or an air strut is replaced, or the car sits at the wrong height with no fault stored.
before: car on level ground at its correct kerb weight, doors and boot shut
ride height measured and set to specification mechanically first
ignition on, engine off, suspension settled
tasks.after: Let the suspension settle, then re-measure the height at each corner to confirm it holds the new target.

tasks.name: Power window initialisation
tasks.what: Reteaches each window its fully-up and fully-down stops so one-touch and anti-trap work again. Needed after the battery is disconnected on some cars, or after a regulator, motor or door module is replaced, when a window only moves while the switch is held.
before: ignition on, doors shut
window glass free to travel its full range and the run channels clear
battery healthy; a low battery mid-cycle leaves the window unnormalised
tasks.after: Test one-touch up and down on each window, and check the anti-trap reverses on an obstruction.

tasks.name: Sunroof initialisation
tasks.what: Reteaches the sunroof its end positions so it runs its full travel and closes properly. Needed after the roof module or motor is replaced, the roof is manually cranked, or it stops part way and refuses to close.
before: ignition on
roof aperture clear, seals and guides free of debris
roof mechanically free through its whole travel
tasks.after: Cycle the roof fully open and fully closed once and confirm it reaches both stops on its own.

tasks.name: Clutch adaptation (SMG / SSG)
tasks.what: Reteaches the automated manual gearbox where its clutch bites and where the shift rails sit. Needed after clutch, actuator or hydraulic work on an SMG or SSG car, when engagement is harsh or the car will not select a gear.
before: engine at operating temperature
hydraulic system bled and pressurised, no actuator faults stored
car on level ground, wheels free or as the script asks, handbrake set
tasks.after: Cycle through the gears and confirm engagement is smooth; some cars want a short low-speed drive to finish learning.

tasks.name: CO / idle mixture adjustment
tasks.what: Writes the idle mixture (CO) trim on the early engines that carry an adjustable one, in place of the mechanical screw. Used when setting idle emissions on cars from before closed-loop control did all of it.
before: engine at operating temperature and idling steadily
exhaust and intake leak free; a leak makes the reading meaningless
a gas analyser on the tailpipe, or the value you intend to write already known
tasks.after: Re-measure at the tailpipe and confirm the reading has moved the way the change intended.

tasks.name: Control unit reset
tasks.what: Restarts the control unit the way a power cycle would, without pulling a fuse. Used to make a coding or adaptation change take effect, and to clear a module that has latched into a fault state.
before: ignition on, engine off
no write in progress; a reset during a coding or flash write can leave the module unusable
engine not running, and the car stationary
tasks.after: Wait for the module to come back on the bus, then read its fault memory and identification to confirm it restarted.

tasks.name: VANOS adaptation reset
tasks.what: Clears the learned camshaft timing offsets so the engine relearns where the VANOS units actually reach. Used after VANOS solenoid, seal or timing work when the module still holds the old offsets.
before: engine at operating temperature
timing correct and VANOS faults repaired first
oil level correct and the oil not overdue; VANOS runs on oil pressure
tasks.after: Let the engine idle and then run it up through the rev range so the offsets relearn, and recheck the VANOS values.
